title: Traveling fronts in a spatial epidemic model with slow loss of immunity
summary: We investigate the emergence of traveling front solutions in a spatial SIRS epidemic model with diffusion acting on the infected population. The model exhibits a natural slow-fast structure due to the presence of a small parameter governing the loss of immunity, which induces a separation of scales in the dynamics. Using a traveling wave reduction, the PDE system is transformed into a singularly perturbed system of ODEs, which we analyze within the framework of Geometric Singular Perturbation Theory.
